meta.title: Email Notifications: on failure — failed emails retried 3x
gaps: Configure the tenant's outbound Email Notifications integration with the specified provider and credentials.
Make the external email provider fail or become unreachable.
Trigger an approval request, bid invitation, PO issuance, or other workflow email.
Observe evidence of exactly three retries and verify that the failed email was not silently dropped.
